battle.name: 復活節起義
battle.theater: 都柏林市中心與利菲河南岸
battle.brief: 一九一六年四月二十四日復活節星期一，愛爾蘭義勇軍與公民軍在都柏林起兵，奪取郵政局與四法院並宣布共和國，至二十九日郵政局守軍退出大樓而告失敗。英軍守備以李-恩菲爾德步槍為步兵主力，配野砲與機槍清剿街壘；起義者只有零星毛瑟與舊式步槍，彈藥無繼，火力差距是敗因之一。

kit.name: 李-恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 英軍於1907年採用此步槍，裝備步兵與支援單位，廣泛用於一次大戰。

countries: 交戰雙方是英國當局與愛爾蘭起義者。英方以駐愛爾蘭英軍為骨幹：駐都柏林的第 3 皇家愛爾蘭團、第 2 皇家都柏林燧發槍兵團與皇家愛爾蘭來福槍團各營，加上第 4 皇家愛爾蘭龍騎近衛團、皇家騎炮兵與皇家駐防炮兵的砲隊，另有皇家愛爾蘭警察與都柏林都會警察一千六百餘人分署維持市區秩序。全線由都柏林守軍指揮官布里格迪爾・約翰・麥克斯韋爾少將統一調度，總督府在 4 月初由法蘭西伯爵接任總督。英方在起義初可用兵力不足三千人，其後由英格蘭與北愛爾蘭調來約四千援軍，連同警察約六千人。愛爾蘭一方是兩支非正規武裝：1913 年 11 月成立的愛爾蘭義勇軍在都柏林編有第一、第二、第三營，合計約一千六百至二千人；1914 年 11 月由詹姆斯・康諾利與詹姆斯・拉金組織的愛爾蘭公民軍，都柏林支部約二百五十人，另有少量前英軍士兵與警察加入。兩個組織名義上互不統屬，復活節派軍事會議才是實際策劃核心，城市的郵政與電報中樞因而成為首要目標。德國是幕後支援者，透過艾克斯金・奇爾德斯與哈里・博蘭的秘密接觸提供軍火與政治許諾。
countriesEn: The two sides were the British authorities in Ireland and the Irish insurgents. On the British side the backbone was the British Army in Ireland: the 3rd Battalion, Royal Irish Regiment, the 2nd Royal Dublin Fusiliers and battalions of the Royal Irish Rifles, together with the 4th Royal Irish Dragoon Guards, the Royal Horse Artillery and the Royal Garrison Artillery, plus some 1,600 Royal Irish Constabulary and Dublin Metropolitan Police officers and men keeping order district by district. Command ran through Brigadier-General John Maxwell, commander of the Dublin garrison, with the Lord Lieutenant's administration reinforced by Lord French from early April. British strength in the city at the outbreak was under three thousand, and roughly four thousand reinforcements were sent from England and from the north of Ireland, bringing the total with police to about six thousand. The Irish side consisted of two non-regular bodies: the Irish Volunteers, founded in November 1913, whose first, second and third Dublin battalions together numbered about sixteen hundred to two thousand men, and the Irish Citizen Army, organised in November 1914 by James Connolly and James Larkin, with some two hundred and fifty men in Dublin, joined by a handful of former British soldiers and policemen. The two organisations were nominally independent of each other, and the Easter group's Military Council was the real planning centre, while the city's postal and telegraph offices became the strategic objectives. Germany was the hidden sponsor, in contact with the Volunteers through Erskine Childers and Harry Boland and supplying both arms and political promises.
people: 決策集中在十幾個人手上。帕特里克・皮爾斯是共和國宣言的主要起草人，4 月 24 日正午在都柏林郵政局門廊宣讀宣言，5 月 12 日被槍決，時年 33 歲。湯瑪士・克拉克以「Éamon MacCoinnich」化名在 4 月 9 日的《愛爾蘭時報》發表〈致國人書〉力主武力起義，4 月 4 日夜由伯克趕回都柏林，5 月 12 日同遭槍決。詩人湯瑪士・麥克多納與西恩・麥克迪爾馬達是宣言簽名人，後者與布萊娜德・索爾克爾德於 24 日上午在郵政局樓頂升起綠白橙三色旗。詹姆斯・康諾利是起義中唯一有英軍正規經歷的指揮官，曾在南非戰爭與英國愛爾蘭護衛隊服役，4 月 25 日夜與皮爾斯會合後接掌全局，5 月 12 日傷重去世，時年 34 歲。愛德華・戴利、喬瑟夫・普倫提特同列宣言七人簽名，普倫提特自 1913 年起推動義勇軍武裝化。艾蒙・肯特率第三營奪下四法院，凱瑟爾・布魯哈自 4 月 26 日起指揮郵政局最後守軍；米歇爾・奧拉希利在起義前數小時中重傷退出戰鬥；皮達・基里尼與湯瑪士・斯特里特於 5 月 3 日首批被處決。艾蒙・德瓦萊拉當時在美國募款，未能返國。英方由麥克斯韋爾主持，駐卡拉格的布里格迪爾・休伯特・高夫所部主導增援北上。
peopleEn: The decisions were concentrated in the hands of a dozen or so men. Patrick Pearse was the principal author of the Republic Proclamation; he read it from the steps of the GPO at noon on the twenty-fourth of April and was shot on the twelfth of May, aged thirty-three. Thomas Clarke published the Note to the Men in The Irish Times on the ninth of April under the pen name of Éamon MacCoinnich, pressing the case for physical force, and returned from Birr in the small hours of the fourth; he was shot on the twelfth of May as well. The poet Thomas MacDonagh and Seán MacDiarmada were signatories of the Proclamation, and MacDiarmada, with Blanaid Salkeld, raised the green, white and orange flag from the roof of the Post Office on the morning of the twenty-fourth. James Connolly was the only commander in the Rising with regular British service behind him, having served in the South African war and in the King's Royal Rifle Corps; only on the night of the twenty-fifth did he make contact with Pearse, after which he directed the whole operation, and he died of his wounds on the twelfth of May, aged thirty-four. Edward Daly and Joseph Plunkett were among the seven signatories, and Plunkett had driven the arming of the Volunteers since 1913. Éamonn Ceannt led the Third Battalion in the seizure of the Four Courts, and Cathal Brugha commanded the last garrison of the Post Office from the twenty-sixth of April onwards. Michael O'Rahilly was badly wounded a few hours before the Rising and dropped out of the fight; Peadar Kearney and Thomas Street were the first two men executed, on the third of May. Éamon de Valera was in the United States raising money and never got back. On the British side the operations were run by Maxwell, with Brigadier-General Hubert Gough's force at the Curragh handling the northward build-up of reinforcements.
kits: 卡面這件李-恩菲爾德步槍，短身李-恩菲爾德第三型，是英軍 1907 年起改裝的制式步兵槍：栓動、.303 口徑、彈匣十發、全槍約 4.2 公斤，長約 1.18 公尺，是都柏林駐軍各步兵營的家當。起義爆發時，第 3 皇家愛爾蘭團、第 2 皇家都柏林燧發槍兵團等營以它封鎖路口、護守營房、逐屋搜索清除街壘，4 月 29 日面對郵政局守軍的正是這種栓動槍的連續射擊。英軍另配維克斯重機槍與路易斯輕機槍，以及皇家騎炮兵的 13 磅野戰砲與 18 磅榴彈砲，砲彈正是壓垮四法院與郵政局守軍的火力。起義者的火力卻是拼湊的：1914 年 6 月在霍斯向英軍退伍士官購得的約一千五百支李-恩菲爾德式後膛槍，同年秋購得的約一千九百支毛瑟式步槍，再加上少量馬丁尼-亨利 .577 舊槍、手槍、手榴彈、剪鐵絲鉗與撬棍。德方原運來的兩萬支步槍與近一百五十萬發 .303 彈藥，恰恰是英軍步槍所用的口徑，卻在 4 月 21 日被皇家海軍在卡林福德灣截走，雙方其實爭的是同一種彈藥，只是其中一方無彈可用。英軍步槍在英格蘭與愛爾蘭守軍手中的壽命也因此延長：它們在街上用刺刀清障，卻也在機槍與砲兵掩護下屢遭還擊，這一點在起義五日的街壘戰中看得最清楚。
kitsEn: The rifle on the card face, the Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mark III, was the standard infantry arm the British Army adopted from 1907: bolt action, .303 calibre, a ten-round magazine, about 4.2 kilograms all up and roughly 1.18 metres long, and it was the arm of the infantry battalions garrisoned in Dublin. When the Rising broke out, the 3rd Royal Irish Regiment, the 2nd Royal Dublin Fusiliers and the other battalions used it to seal junctions, guard barracks and search the streets house by house as they cleared the barricades, and the last assault of the twenty-ninth of April against the Post Office was carried in the face of continuous bolt-action fire from exactly this weapon. The British also had Vickers heavy machine guns and Lewis light machine guns, together with the 13-pounder field gun and the 18-pounder howitzer of the Royal Horse Artillery, and it was artillery fire that broke the defenders of the Four Courts and the Post Office. The insurgents' firepower, by contrast, was cobbled together: some fifteen hundred Lee-Enfield pattern rifles bought from British non-commissioned officers at Howth in June 1914, about nineteen hundred Mauser pattern rifles bought in the autumn of the same year, plus a handful of obsolete Martini-Henry .577 rifles, pistols, hand grenades, wire cutters and crowbars. The twenty thousand rifles and close to one and a half million rounds of .303 ammunition that Germany was bringing over were in exactly the calibre used by the British rifle, but the Royal Navy intercepted them in Carlingford Lough on the twenty-first of April, so the two sides were in truth contesting the same ammunition, except that one of them never received it. The life of the SMLE in England and in the Irish garrison was prolonged by the emergency, and it was used with the bayonet to break down barricades while coming under return fire from machine guns and artillery, a pattern of street fighting plainly visible in the five days of the Rising.
tactics: 起義的計畫從未真正統一下來，行動被拆成互不協調的奪點。4 月 24 日上午，義勇軍在市中心的郵政局、法院大樓、市政廳與聖史蒂芬綠園同時出手：一支部隊切斷電報線並佔領郵政局，一支部隊奪四法院，其餘小隊散發宣言，全城沒有第二階段計畫。郵政局的防守最具代表性：底層入口用沙袋與家具封死，門外築起路障，機槍控制奧康奈爾街與後巷，樓上窗口由步槍手伏射，守軍以印刷機印出宣言廣為散發，還企圖以郵政局自己的電報機向倫敦發報。英軍以英式街壘清剿應對：以連、營封鎖路口，機槍佔據街角制高點，逐屋搜索殘餘，最後由騎炮兵以 13 磅砲向郵政局立面直射，市區樓宇在砲火中受損嚴重。起義方的弱點同樣明顯：沒有統一指揮、沒有無線電，各點互不支援，多數射手未經射擊訓練，只帶零散彈藥，星期一狂風大雨令紙包彈藥受潮，全城沒有撤退與補給安排。雙方在窄街對射時，英軍的固定射界、連續射擊與砲兵投射量，遠非射擊不穩的起義方所能抵擋。
tacticsEn: The plan for the Rising was never properly coordinated, and the operation broke down into a set of uncoordinated individual seizures. On the morning of the twenty-fourth of April the Volunteers struck at several points across central Dublin at once: one party cut the telegraph lines and took the Post Office, another seized the Four Courts, and small groups distributed copies of the Proclamation in the streets. There was no second stage to the plan for the city. The defence of the Post Office is the clearest example. The ground-floor entrances were sealed with sandbags and furniture, a barricade was raised outside the doors, machine guns covered O'Connell Street and the rear lanes, riflemen fired from the upper windows, the garrison printed the Proclamation on its own press and scattered copies, and it even tried to reach London over the Post Office's own telegraph. The British answered with the European method of clearing a street: cordons of companies and battalions sealing each junction, machine guns holding the corners, houses searched one by one, and finally the Royal Horse Artillery firing the 13-pounder directly at the face of the Post Office, with the buildings of the city badly damaged by shellfire. The weaknesses of the Irish side were just as plain. There was no unified command and no wireless, so each position fought on its own. Most riflemen had no shooting training, carried only a handful of loose rounds, and the gale and heavy rain of the Monday soaked paper-wrapped ammunition, while no route of retreat or resupply had been planned anywhere in the city. In a duel fought down narrow streets, the British advantage in fixed fields of fire, rate of fire and weight of artillery was far beyond what the insurgents' erratic shooting could offset.
data: 數字可以說明為何守不住。起義自 4 月 24 日正午至 29 日傍晚，前後不足六日；郵政局抵抗五天，4 月 29 日下午最後約六十名守軍退出大樓，大樓在當晚砲火中燒毀；四法院在 4 月 25 日下午砲擊下投降，守軍約一百五十人。市區的英軍與警察在起義初約三千人，週末前增至約六千人，其中約四千由英格蘭調來；愛爾蘭義勇軍在都柏林能上街者約一千六百至二千人，公民軍都柏林支部約二百五十人。損失極不對稱：起義一方陣亡約二百五十至三百二十人，另有約一千六百五十人被俘，其中約一千四百六十人被押往威爾斯弗朗戈奇營地羈押；英軍與警察陣亡約八十人、受傷數百人。1916 年 5 月先後有十六名起義領導人被處決，至 1920 年被處決者累計一百四十六人。武器上，英軍制式栓動槍受訓射速約每分鐘十至十五發、.303 彈匣十發，起義者的舊式單發槍每分鐘僅能射二至四發。距離上，郵政局至四法院約一公里，至都柏林堡約一公里半，霍斯海灘距市中心約十三公里。砲兵方面，13 磅野戰砲的炮彈重約 5.9 公斤，18 磅榴彈砲炮彈約 8.2 公斤。軍火上，1914 年購得的一千五百支李-恩菲爾德式後膛槍與約一千九百支毛瑟，是起義者手中為數不多的近代步槍，而 4 月 21 日在卡林福德灣被截的兩萬支 .303 步槍並未到手。
dataEn: The figures explain why the Rising could not be held. It ran from noon on the twenty-fourth of April to the evening of the twenty-ninth, less than six days in all. The Post Office resisted for five of them; on the afternoon of the twenty-ninth some sixty men of the last garrison withdrew from the building, which was burned out by shellfire that night. The Four Courts surrendered under artillery fire on the afternoon of the twenty-fifth, its garrison of about a hundred and fifty men. In the city the British troops and police numbered about three thousand at the outset and rose to about six thousand before the weekend, roughly four thousand of them sent from England. About sixteen hundred to two thousand Irish Volunteers could take to the streets of Dublin, with some two hundred and fifty Citizen Army men in the city. The losses were sharply lopsided: between two hundred and fifty and three hundred and twenty of the insurgents were killed and about one thousand six hundred and fifty taken prisoner, of whom some one thousand four hundred and sixty were interned at the Frongoch camp in Wales; on the British side about eighty soldiers and policemen were killed and several hundred wounded. Sixteen leaders of the Rising were executed in the first half of May 1916, and the number executed rose to one hundred and forty-six by 1920. On weapons, the trained rate of fire of the British service rifle was about ten to fifteen rounds a minute with a ten-round .303 magazine, whereas the obsolete single-shot arms in Irish hands could manage only two to four rounds a minute. On distances, the GPO lay about a kilometre from the Four Courts and about a kilometre and a half from Dublin Castle, and Howth beach was some thirteen kilometres from the city centre. On artillery, the 13-pounder field gun fired a shell of about 5.9 kilograms and the 18-pounder howitzer one of about 8.2. On arms, the fifteen hundred Lee-Enfield pattern rifles and roughly nineteen hundred Mausers bought in 1914 were among the few modern rifles in Irish hands, while the twenty thousand .303 rifles intercepted in Carlingford Lough on the twenty-first of April never arrived.
cause: 打起上來的緣由有四層。第一層是自治法案：英國國會自 1912 年起屢次提出愛爾蘭自治方案，1914 年被《溫莎宮法案》暫緩，1916 年 4 月第三度提交，而 4 月 21 日召開的自治會議仍建議戰時押後，愛爾蘭政治因此裂成兩半，支持自治者與北部反對自治者各自武裝，義勇軍正是在這種對立中成立並加速武裝化。第二層是新芬黨內的路線之爭：1916 年 3 月 20 日例會上以德瓦萊拉為首的議會派與皮爾斯、克拉克、康諾利為首的復活節派分道揚鑳，武裝起義成為黨內分裂的產物。第三層是戰時壓力：糧食短缺、物價上漲，英國於 4 月 18 日提出徵兵案，青年被迫在加入英軍與加入愛爾蘭之間抉擇，軍中大批士兵開小差返鄉。第四層是德國的招手：一戰中德國急欲削弱英國，許諾一旦愛爾蘭起事便提供軍火、外交干涉，甚至派飛艇襲擊都柏林，義勇軍的「後援計畫」正是把起義與德國援助綁在一起，4 月 21 日德方軍火船在卡林福德灣被皇家海軍截獲，起義遂在武裝最不完整的時刻發動。
causeEn: Four layers lie behind the outbreak. The first is the Home Rule question. The British parliament had brought forward Irish home rule repeatedly since 1912, suspended it in 1914 under the Windsor House Act, and returned to it for a third time in April 1916, while the Home Rule conference of the twenty-first of April still recommended postponement for the duration of the war. Ireland therefore split politically in two, with nationalists who wanted home rule and a northern unionist party each holding armed men, and the Irish Volunteers arose out of that confrontation and armed themselves faster as it hardened. The second is the argument inside Sinn Féin: at its conference of the twentieth of March 1916 the parliamentary wing of Éamon de Valera parted company with the Easter group of Pearse, Clarke and Connolly, and the insurrection became the product of that split. The third is the pressure of war: short food supplies, rising prices, and the conscription bill introduced in Britain on the eighteenth of April forced young men to choose between joining the British Army and joining Ireland, while soldiers left the colours in large numbers. The fourth is the German invitation. Germany wanted badly to weaken Britain, and promised arms, diplomatic intervention and even an airship raid on Dublin once an Irish rising began; the Volunteers' Plan de recours was built to tie the insurrection to German support, and when the German arms ship was intercepted by the Royal Navy in Carlingford Lough on the twenty-first of April, the Rising had to be launched at the moment when its equipment was at its most incomplete.
impact: 軍事上失敗，政治上卻成了愛爾蘭民族認同的起點。共和國從未取得任何國家的外交承認，宣布的政權只維持了五天；但德國在戰時印製並空投宣言文本，起義對抗英帝國的形象在戰後成為國際宣傳的題材，一九一六年遂由一次起兵變成一段共同的記憶與命名，爾後每年的紀念儀式、以 1916 命名的街道與場所都由此而立。共和派此後逐漸整合：1917 年新芬黨合併、德瓦萊拉當選主席，1919 年 1 月國會宣布成立、自立議會通過《獨立宣言》，全面戰爭隨即展開；1920 年北愛爾蘭成立並留在英聯邦之內，1921 年 12 月《英愛條約》簽訂，1922 年 12 月愛爾蘭自由邦成立。英國方面的政策亦因此調整：撤換都柏林守軍指揮官麥克斯韋爾，成立愛爾蘭問題皇家委員會，1918 年修改武器法逐步停止追究民間持有的步槍，並在 1918 年 11 月召開愛爾蘭國會會議。1916 至 1922 年間被稱為愛爾蘭文學復興的寫作潮，蕭伯納、吉姆・謝立頓與佩達・奧唐奈的小說把起義經驗寫成政治文本。就戰術而言，起義示範了城市起義可以在數日內癱瘓一整座都柏林，但缺乏民眾自發配合、彈藥、人手與統一指揮，就無法把騷亂變成政權更替。
impactEn: It failed militarily and yet became the starting point of Irish national identity. The republic was never acknowledged by any state, and the regime it proclaimed lasted five days. Yet Germany printed the Proclamation and dropped copies of it over Ireland during the war, the image of a rising against the British Empire became material for international propaganda after the war, and 1916 turned from a single insurrection into a shared memory and a name: the commemorations held every year and the streets and places named for 1916 all grew out of it. The republican tendency then closed ranks: Sinn Féin was reunited in 1917 with de Valera as president, in January 1919 the Dáil declared itself and the Assembly of Ireland adopted the Declaration of Independence, and a general war followed; Northern Ireland was established in 1920 and stayed inside the United Kingdom, the Anglo-Irish Treaty was signed in December 1921, and the Irish Free State came into being in December 1922. British policy adjusted in turn: the Dublin garrison commander Maxwell was relieved of his post, a royal commission on the Irish question was set up, the arms law was amended in 1918 so that the prosecution of private rifle ownership was gradually abandoned, and an Irish parliament was convened in November of the same year. The years from 1916 to 1922 produced what is called the Irish literary renaissance, with Shaw, Jim Sheridan and Peadar O'Donnell turning the experience of the Rising into political writing. Tactically the Rising demonstrated that an urban insurrection can paralyse an entire city for a few days, but without spontaneous support from the population, and without ammunition, manpower and unified command, disorder cannot be turned into a change of government.
result: 結果是起義被平定，共和國並未成立。4 月 25 日，四法院在砲擊下投降，聖史蒂芬綠園與市政廳的守軍同日出樓；其後各處據點相繼失守，4 月 29 日下午郵政局最後一批守軍接到撤退命令，凱瑟爾・布魯哈在退出大樓後因傷重身亡，英軍當晚完全控制市中心；4 月 30 日，艾蒙・肯特與西恩・奧康奈爾在莫爾街一帶與麥克斯韋爾談判後交出國旗，最後一批守軍解散。英方隨即展開大規模拘捕，約一千六百五十名義勇軍成員入獄，其中約一千四百六十人被押往威爾斯羈押，1916 年 5 月 3 日與 12 日先後有十六名起義領導人被處決，其後羈押條件在山喬伊監獄的絕食中急劇惡化，餘波延續至 1923 年。長期後果是路線的改變：起義把共和派從憲制改革推向武裝鬥爭，1919 年開始的獨立戰爭最終迫使英國承認愛爾蘭大部分地區脫離聯邦，而北愛爾蘭仍留在英聯邦之內。1916 年的失敗也留下三條清楚教訓——城市起義必須有全國性組織與外部援助作後盾；起義者需要統一指揮、可持續的彈藥補給與像樣的訓練；一份宣言加上數千支步槍，並不足以推翻一座城市的守備力量。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Rising was suppressed and that the republic was never established. On the twenty-fifth of April the Four Courts surrendered under shellfire and the garrisons of Stephen's Green and the City Hall came out of their buildings the same day; position after position fell through the rest of the week; and on the afternoon of the twenty-ninth the last garrison of the Post Office received the order to withdraw, Cathal Brugha dying of his wounds after he came out of the building, with British troops in complete control of the city centre that night. On the thirtieth, Éamonn Ceannt and Seán O'Connell spoke with Maxwell around Moore Street and handed over the Irish flags before the last group dispersed. The British then mounted large-scale arrests: some one thousand six hundred and fifty Volunteers went to prison and about one thousand four hundred and sixty of them were interned in Wales; sixteen leaders of the Rising were executed on the third and twelfth of May 1916; and the conditions of imprisonment then deteriorated sharply with the hunger strike at Mountjoy Prison, the aftershocks of the week running on until 1923. The long-term consequence was a change of line. The Rising drove the republican movement from constitutional reform towards armed struggle, and the war of independence that began in 1919 eventually forced Britain to concede that most of Ireland would leave the United Kingdom, while the north remained inside it. The failure of 1916 also left three plain lessons: an urban insurrection needs a national organisation and outside support behind it; the insurgents need unified command, a sustainable supply of ammunition and proper training; and a proclamation together with a few thousand rifles is not enough to break the defence of a city.
